buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC (Additional Terms and Conditions) 1. Technical Specifications, Included Accessories & Warranty: Scope & Quantity: Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of 1 No. A3 Monochrome La ser Multifunction Machine (Print, Copy, Scan) for State Head Office/PMU, Directorate of Social Welfare, Andhra Pradesh. Hardware Configuration & Mandatory Inclusions: The machine must be a brand-new, curre nt-generation, factory-sealed commercial model (minimum 30 ppm A4 speed / 32 ppm class, automatic duplex, DADF/RADF, 2 × 550-sheet paper cassettes + 100-sheet bypass tray, minimum 2 GB RAM, 64 GB storage, 7-inch colour touch panel, Gigabit LAN + Wi-Fi) supplied complete with ma tching floor pedestal/trolley, initial starter toner cartridge, drum unit, and power/networ k cables. Refurbished, reconditioned, or end-of-life models will be summarily rejected. Technical da tasheet of the offered model must be uploaded with the bid. Warranty: 3 Years Comprehensive On-Site Warranty. The quoted bid price shall be on a Free on Rail (F.O.R.) Destination (Doorstep Delivery) basis, inclusive of packing, freight, transit ins urance, unloading, installation, network integration, and operator training at the consignee location, with no extra cost to the Buyer. 2. Delivery Location, Pre-Dispatch Spec Confirmation & Post-Delivery Verification: Delivery Location: Delivery and installation must be made at the State Head Office/PMU or any de signated office location within Andhra Pradesh. The Buyer reserves the right to specify or modify the delivery address within Andhra Pradesh prior to dispatch at no extra cost. Mandatory Contact & Spec Confirmation Before Dispatch: After bid award, the Seller must c ontact the Buyer in writing/email prior to dispatch to confirm exact make/model specification s as per the bid, verify site/power readiness, and obtain written dispatch clearance. Any dispatch m ade without prior buyer clearance shall be at the Seller's sole risk and cost.

Post-Delivery Verification: Upon installation and commissioning, machine specifications, serial n umber, and print/copy/scan test output will be verified and certified by the Inspecting Officer prior t o CRAC and payment processing. 3. Service Support & Escalation Compliance in Andhra Pradesh: The Bidder must ensure prompt on-site warranty and after-sales engineering support in Andhra Pra desh. Along with the technical bid, the Bidder must upload: (a) details of existing authorized service center(s) / support office in Andhra Pradesh (with address, contact details, and valid registration/GS T proof), OR a signed undertaking on company letterhead to establish functional service support co verage in Andhra Pradesh within 30 days of contract award as per GeM ATC norms, and (b) a dedica ted toll-free/helpline number and service escalation matrix. . 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 7. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted.
